calibration.surprise_note: Aggregate diagnostic EV and PnL were positive, but that apparent improvement was concentrated in late_strong and in correlated issuer legs rather than independent release decisions.

change_summary: Built and evaluated a hash-bound shared default-off FAERS serious-share improvement quarterly basket; rejected it because the additive positive diagnostic failed window replacement value, independent-decision, concentration, and cash-conservation gates.

hypothesis: Shared-paper-first candidate-pool alpha: among strictly mapped liquid Healthcare issuers, a quarter-over-quarter decline in official FDA FAERS serious-outcome share is a safety-quality signal; rank only improving issuers, cap the ten largest improvements per quarterly release, allocate one equal-weight 10000 USD event basket at the first PIT session open, and close at the twentieth-session close with 35 bps round-trip cost.
next_retry_requires: At least 30 independent prospectively settled quarterly release decisions under the unchanged policy, with at least 10 independent decisions in each standard window.
An explicit cash-conserving funding and displacement contract for the 10000 USD event basket.
An effective-dated sponsor or product-exposure relation that removes current-title issuer-mapping survivorship; otherwise use an independent PIT data source or genuinely different gate shape.
notes: Gate 4 hard failures: one EV-regressing window; only six independent quarterly release decisions (two per window); old_thin lost cash/SPY/QQQ and mid_weak lost SPY/QQQ; top-five positive PnL share 76.11%; additive 10000 USD overlay did not model a cash-conserving funding source. DSR not computable and non-selecting; no live orders changed.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retune issuer identity, serious-outcome definition, case-count or volume-ratio guards, delta threshold, rank/top-N, entry timing, hold length, notional, or trading cost on the same frozen quarters. Do not count correlated issuer legs as independent decisions.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Reopen only after at least 30 independent prospectively settled quarterly release decisions under the unchanged policy (at least 10 per standard window), together with an explicit cash-conserving funding/displacement contract and an effective-dated sponsor or product-exposure relation; otherwise require an independent PIT source or genuinely different gate shape.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The additive external-capital diagnostic gained 0.1033 EV and 1140.27 USD, but the gain was late-window-driven: old_thin lost cash/SPY/QQQ, mid_weak lost SPY/QQQ, and only late_strong passed replacement value. Forty-one issuer legs represented just six correlated quarterly release decisions, top-five positive-PnL concentration reached 76.11%, and the overlay did not model where its 10000 USD of capital came from.

prediction.confidence_reason: A preregistered zero-ID preflight on seven hash-bound official FAERS quarterly ASCII extracts passed every window at 12/14/15 selected issuer-releases, 11/12/14 tickers, and top1 below 17%; unlike the prior zero-ID core-entry exclusion, this is a standalone quarterly candidate-pool gate.

rejection_reason: Gate 4 failed because one of three windows regressed in EV; the sample contained only six independent quarterly release decisions (two per window, below 30 overall and 10 per window); old_thin failed cash, SPY, and QQQ replacement value and mid_weak failed SPY and QQQ; top-five positive-PnL concentration was 76.11% versus the 60% cap; and the additive overlay lacked a cash-conserving funding source.
new_evidence_axis: Seven SHA-256-bound official FDA FAERS quarterly PIT ASCII extracts (2024Q2-2025Q4) feeding a standalone quarterly candidate-pool gate; the prior FAERS probe was only a core-entry exclusion and touched 0/0/1 core trades.
